My husband and I and my mother-in-law wishes for me to have twin sons soon InshaAllah. I am not yet pregnant, but we pray that Allah grant us twin boys InshaAllah when I do become pregnant.I would like to know if there are any special duas/wazifas I can do for having twin boy babies soon InshaAllah. I kindly seek your advice. Question: I have recently been married, Alhamdulillah. My husband and I and my mother-in-law wishes for me to have twin sons soon InshaAllah. I am not yet pregnant, but we pray that Allah grant us twin boys InshaAllah when I do become pregnant.I would like to know if there are any special duas/wazifas I can do for having twin boy babies soon InshaAllah. I kindly seek your advice. Answer ID: 9736 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2598/2083=H/1429) Recite the below Dua 100 times after every obligatory salah : ھب لنا من ازواجنا و ذریاتنا قرۃ اعین واجعلنا للمتقین اماما (الفرقان 74) Leave the thought of twin etc and prefer what is granted by Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
